title: PoseLab · Measured research comparison

protocol.split: 400 held-out clips sampled from official validation; separate 200-clip calibration
protocol.selection: Ascending SHA256(seed + ':' + clip_id); first calibration_count for calibration, subsequent test_count for test; no empty-pose or class filtering
protocol.subset_limitation: A 400-clip pilot, not reproduction of full-paper benchmark scores; controlled joint masking is not physical camera occlusion. Upstream validation data may have informed the authors' checkpoint selection.
protocol.description: Same pretrained weights, same original preprocessing, same clips and corruption masks. Recovery and rejection settings frozen on a disjoint 200-clip calibration set.
protocol.corruptions: 5-frame joint and limb dropout, 15-frame dropout, coordinate jitter; clean condition retained.
protocol.timing_scope: Mean synchronized model processing time per 300-frame clip in batches; recovery runs on CPU. Excludes transfers, camera pose estimation, I/O and browser. Not per-frame streaming latency.
protocol.macro_f1_scope: Macro average over the 251 true classes represented in the held-out test subset; classifier retains all 400 outputs.

variants.label: Original model
variants.description: Authors' pretrained CoST-GCN* equivalent clip path; unchanged weights.

variants.label: With joint recovery
variants.description: Same classifier with bounded causal pose repair.

variants.label: With rejection only
variants.description: Original model, with calibration-selected rejection threshold.

variants.label: Recovery + rejection
variants.description: Recovery and a separately calibrated prediction threshold.

calibration.development_note: Development used three calibration-only rounds: four initial recipes, two additional last-score hold recipes, and finally one high-confidence hold recipe. The earlier rounds are retained under calibration-round1 and calibration-round2. All seven candidates were compared in the final calibration. No held-out test predictions were used to choose the method.

notes: All accuracy/F1 values count abstentions as incorrect. Accepted accuracy must be interpreted together with coverage.
Settings were selected on calibration clips only; no training or fine-tuning on test clips.
Recovery reuses prior positions within confidence-ranked person slots. These slots are not guaranteed persistent identities; identity switches remain a limitation.
Model quality is limited by the authors' 400-class 2D pose-only checkpoint. NTU 3D benchmark scores do not apply to this experiment.
Qualitative examples are the first gain, regression and shared failure in deterministic test order, where available. Their captions are clip-level predictions, not per-frame predictions.
